run_gen_detection_multicore: run gen_detection_multicore to generate EGO4D detection results across all videos in parallel
run_Soft_NMS: run Soft_NMS on a DataFrame to filter overlapping temporal proposals using Gaussian score decay
run_IOU: run IOU to compute the intersection over union of two temporal segments given start and end times
run_gen_detection_video: run _gen_detection_video to generate labeled detection proposals for a single video from snippet CSVs
review_Soft_NMS: review Soft_NMS to understand how it suppresses overlapping temporal proposals using an exponential decay function
